title.en: Keep Diesel 40 Concrete Pump as printed while Channel Tunnel only supplies the map

description.en: The Diesel 40 Concrete Pump note follows the outline of Channel Tunnel. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel 40 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Diesel Engine (Power) 4108 / 66 kW; Theoretical Output 26 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 2800 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵这篇笔记顺着《Channel Tunnel》的大纲写。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油40型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：柴油机功率4108 / 66 kW；理论输送量26 m³/h；最大出口压力25 MPa；料斗容积0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）120 m / 360 m；液压泵Kawasaki 112；外形尺寸4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm；整机重量2800 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
